doc_requests.documents: As the account would be funded and operated by your relative Noah Weyland, bank policy (beneficial ownership) requires us to identify and verify him before opening: (1) a valid government-issued ID for Noah Weyland, and (2) a signed beneficial-owner declaration. Please note that where Mr Weyland owns and controls the funds, the account should normally be in his name (or he must be formally identified as beneficial owner); we cannot open it solely in your name as a nominee.
